intro: Southridge Beach stretches along the southern shores of the Bay of Storms in central Azshara. Once a grand district of the ancient kaldorei city of Eldarath, its shattered ruins are now overrun by hostile naga, murlocs, and towering sea giants.

p: Southridge Beach forms the southern boundary of the turbulent Bay of Storms. Thousands of years ago, this coast was part of the magnificent Highborne city of Eldarath, but the Great Sundering broke the land and plunged most of its palaces beneath the tides. Today, crumbling marble pillars and weathered stone pavilions dot the sand. Rather than scholars and noble courtiers, the strand is contested by aggressive Spitelash naga, prowling makrura, vicious hydras, and scavenging murloc tribes. Even massive sea giants occasionally wander ashore from the deeps.
